Job Details:

Job Description: 
The Role and Impact 
As a DFT Design Engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing and delivering high-quality design-for-test (DFT) solutions for cutting-edge semiconductor products. You will focus on logic design, RTL coding, and simulation, while collaborating on architecture and microarchitecture definitions. Your contributions directly impact product quality and manufacturability by optimizing test coverage, debug efficiency, and production ramp-up, ensuring Intel's leadership in advanced SoC designs. 

Business group 
The Data Center Group (DCG) drives innovation in data center technologies to empower businesses and industries globally. As part of this high-impact organization, you will contribute to the development of world-class systems and solutions that support Intel's vision to transform data into actionable insights, enabling scalable, efficient, and secure computing. 

Key Responsibilities 
- Develop logic design, RTL coding, and DFT timing closure support for test content generation, including SCAN, MBIST, and BSCAN. 
- Collaborate on the definition of architecture and microarchitecture features for blocks and subsystems under DFT design. 
- Create and optimize HVM content for rapid bring-up and production ramp on automatic test equipment (ATE). 
- Apply strategies, tools, and methods to integrate DFT into RTL and structural code while meeting power, performance, area, and timing goals. 
- Review verification plans and drive verification of DFT designs to ensure alignment with architecture and microarchitecture specifications. 
- Resolve RTL test failures and implement corrective measures to ensure design accuracy and feature correctness. 
- Integrate DFT blocks into functional IP and SoC, supporting SoC customers to ensure seamless integration and high-quality design outcomes. 
- Collaborate with post-silicon and manufacturing teams to support debug and verification on silicon, documenting learnings for continuous improvement. 
- Drive high test coverage and develop structural and specific IP tests to achieve quality and defect-per-million (DPM) objectives.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications 
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 0-1 years of hands-on experience through internships, academic projects, coursework, or training. 
- OR a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with no prior professional experience. 
- Proficiency in RTL coding and simulation tools (e.g., SystemVerilog, VCS). 
- Foundational understanding of DFT methodologies such as SCAN, MBIST, and BSCAN. 

Preferred Qualifications 
- Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset. 
- Familiarity with SoC architecture and microarchitecture features. 
- Knowledge of test equipment tools and strategies for production ramp-up. 
- Passion for innovation and commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
About AskGalore

AskGalore Digital is an AI-driven transformation company building intelligent solutions for enterprise clients. We combine deep technical expertise in AI/ML, modern software development, and design to modernize legacy systems, scale automation across organizations, and solve mission-critical business problems. 

About the Role

At AskGalore we build AI-powered automations that solve real, messy business problems for global clients. This role is a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - you sit between our finance-domain business analysts and the working software, translating real-world process logic into production-grade automations powered by Claude and other LLMs.

This is not a model-training, data-science, or MLOps role. It's for a strong full-stack engineer who has learned to build dramatically faster with AI and wants that to be the core of the job, someone who uses AI to the hilt to design, build, test, and ship.If you started your career writing full-stack code and have grown into shipping AI-driven automations and agentic workflows, this role is built for you.

What You Will Do

• Work directly with finance-domain BAs to turn business logic and process rules into automated, end-to-end workflows.

• Design, build, and deploy complex automations orchestrated with Claude / LLMs — prompt engineering, tool use (function calling), and multi-step agentic workflows.

• Build the full stack around the AI: APIs, backend services, integrations, and lightweight dashboards.

• Use AI-powered QA agents to test, validate, and harden what you ship.

• Integrate automations with client systems — databases, ERPs, third-party APIs, and webhooks.

• Deploy at the point of use, iterate fast on real feedback, and own outcomes rather than tickets.

• Write clean, modular, well-documented code with proper version control.

You’ll thrive here if you

• Began in full-stack development and grew into AI-powered building — you now ship 10x faster because AI is part of how you work, not a side experiment.

• Think like a product engineer: you research, prototype, build, and deploy independently.

• Are comfortable talking to non-technical domain experts and turning ambiguity into working software.

• Move fast, take ownership, and care about the result landing with the client.

What You Bring

Core (Must-Have)

• A strong full-stack foundation (Python + JavaScript/TypeScript; React/Node or equivalent).

• Solid backend / API development and systems integration — REST APIs, webhooks, databases, authentication.

• Hands-on experience building real automations with LLMs (Claude, GPT, or similar): prompt engineering, tool use / function calling, and agentic / multi-step workflows.

• Fluency with AI coding tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot — you build with AI every day.

• Experience with workflow automation platforms or frameworks (n8n, Temporal, Zapier, Make, or custom orchestration).

• Clean, production-quality code with documentation and Git-based version control

Nice-to-Have

• Exposure to finance / FinTech domain or process automation.

• Competitive Programming & Technical Assessments: Candidates are invited to include verifiable credentials, ranks, or assessment scores from recognized platforms—such as LeetCode, CodeSignal, HackerRank, Codeforces, CodeChef, or Kaggle—to demonstrate technical problem-solving proficiency.

• RAG, vector databases, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool-connected agents.

• Basic cloud + Docker for deployment.

• Familiarity with AI-driven testing / QA agents.

Note: This role does not require Computer Vision, NLP research, deep learning, or model training. We're looking for builders, not researchers.

What we offer

• A rare chance to be an early, senior AI-automation hire with real influence over how we build.

• Genuinely interesting problems — you'll ship AI automations that go live with global clients, not demos.

• Autonomy and ownership from day one, working shoulder-to-shoulder with domain experts and founders.

• Competitive compensation of ₹12–18 LPA based on experience and demonstrated ability.

Required Skill Set

Python (FastAPI), LLMs (LangGraph, LangChain, Pydantic), RAG and Vector Databases, AWS and Azure, Vibe coding, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, Docker and Kubernetes, Langfuse/LangSmith for observability. 

Why This Role

• Real work, real impact: You'll contribute to systems used by actual clients, not throwaway assignments

• Steep learning curve: Work directly with experienced engineers and consultants who will mentor you

• AI-first exposure: Get hands-on with RAG pipelines and agentic workflows — skills that are in high demand

• Career runway: Strong performers will be considered for full-time AI/ML Engineer roles

• Startup pace, structured mentorship: Move fast, ask questions, and grow quickly in a supportive team

 - Test and evaluate designs: Conduct usability testing on existing interfaces and new prototypes, run preference and A/B tests, and benchmark experiences against other developer products.

 - Turn research into insights: Analyse qualitative and quantitative data, identify patterns and present clear recommendations to product, design, growth and support teams.

 - Strong curiosity about user behaviour and a genuine interest in understanding why people use products the way they do.

 - Comfortable working with data, analysing spreadsheets and interpreting product funnels or dashboards.

 - Familiarity with AI tools and developer products, and an interest in exploring how they can improve research workflows.

 - Familiarity with user research methodologies, usability testing and survey design.

 - Previous research projects, internships or personal projects involving products you've built or shipped.

Hevo is a Series B data infrastructure company with $42M raised.

The people building the product are the people deciding what to build.

We are building an AI system that creates data connectors by itself and keeps them working by itself.
No engineer should need to manually build every connector. No engineer should need to come back six months later because the source API changed.
Work that traditionally takes weeks or months should take hours. But building a connector is not the hardest part.
The real question is: Would you trust this system to run by itself, with nobody watching, for months?
That is the job.
What you’ll own as Associate SDE at Hevo:
Implement SaaS connectors for assigned applications, learning application specific nuances like basic auth and data extraction.
Assist in building simple REST API components, focusing on clean implementation and testing.
Debug and optimize code for data pipeline efficiency under mentorship.
Contribute to feature breakdown, coding, and documentation for smaller tasks.
Apply logical thinking to solve integration issues and improve component quality.
Build internal tools with AI for business teams to run their functions
 
What you’ll bring to the table:
Basic object-oriented programming skills and familiarity with design principles.
Exposure to data pipelines or APIs; eagerness to learn concurrency and performance basics.
Foundational knowledge of REST APIs (e.g., making calls, handling JSON) – no deep expertise needed.
Proficiency in Java/TypeScript/Python, good problem-solving with data structures and algorithms.
Strong analytical and logical thinking for real-world challenges.

Freshers with experience in software development, ideally with internships in integrations or data tools.
B Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed college.

Very few teams are building autonomous AI systems that operate production infrastructure where being wrong has real consequences.
This is not a chatbot. It is infrastructure that has to remain correct, quietly, for months.
If that kind of problem excites you, there are not many places working on it this early.
You can talk to anyone in the company, including the CEO.
What you are trusted with depends on what you can do, not your title.

jobs.description:
About this role

Your team

Aladdin Data builds and supports data solutions that enable teams to organize, understand, and use data effectively across the platform. The team works across structured, unstructured, and graph data, connecting information into meaningful business domains and broader enterprise data models.

Your role and impact

As a Data Engineer within Aladdin Data, you will build scalable data solutions and develop strong data models that connect technology with business context. You will work across the data lifecycle, from pipeline development and modeling through performance optimization and production, while taking ownership of ambiguous technical problems and translating business concepts into effective data solutions.

Your responsibilities

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

• Build and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines and data products.

• Design data models across structured, unstructured, and graph data.

• Organize data into well-defined business domains and connect them into a broader enterprise ontology.

• Understand business processes through data and translate business concepts into well-designed data solutions.

• Improve the performance, scalability, and efficiency of data workloads.

• Independently investigate problems and own solutions from design through production.

Your experience

• Strong hands-on knowledge of Snowflake, including performance, warehouse utilization, cost optimization, and capabilities such as Snowpipe, Tasks, Streams, Dynamic Tables, and Cortex services.

• Experience building data solutions using Structured Query Language (SQL), dbt, and Python/Snowpark.

• Experience building and operating data orchestration pipelines using directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing, Prefect, or similar technologies.

• Strong understanding of data modeling, including entities, relationships, domains, and semantic models; familiarity with graph databases, knowledge graphs, and ontologies is beneficial.

• Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity independently and understand the business context represented by the data.

• Experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases and exposure to data platforms supporting artificial intelligence, search, or retrieval-based applications is beneficial.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

In this position, you will define, develop, and execute validation plans for integrated SoCs, focusing on post-silicon validation, debugging, and optimization. ABOUT SARVAM

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Marketing Intern to help execute high-priority initiatives across Sarvam’s marketing function. You will work on a varied mix of market research, campaigns, product marketing, events and content, collaborating closely with teams across Marketing, Product, GTM and Design.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can bring structure to open-ended problems, move quickly from idea to execution and maintain a high bar for quality. Your work will contribute directly to how Sarvam takes its products to market, engages enterprise and developer audiences, and shows up across digital and in-person channels.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build campaigns across content, search, paid and community channels, from audience and messaging to execution and measurement.

 - Work with Product, GTM and Marketing on launches, product assets and new growth initiatives.

 - Plan and execute conferences, roundtables, meetups and other offline experiences across vendors, logistics, communication and on-ground delivery.

 - Help grow developer and enterprise communities through events, partnerships, webinars and ongoing engagement.

 - Improve Sarvam’s discoverability across SEO, content and AI-powered search.

 - Conduct market, customer and competitive research, turning findings into clear briefs and recommendations.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - High agency and execution ability, with a track record of taking ownership and delivering high-quality work.

 - Strong organisation and follow-through; calm and detail-oriented under deadline pressure.

 - Clear writing and structured thinking, with the ability to communicate ideas simply.

 - Strong growth instincts across audience, message, channel, experimentation and measurement.

 - Fluency with modern AI tools, with the ability to build workflows and automations that improve research, content, analysis and execution.

 - Comfort with marketing tools such as CRM, email and basic analytics




GOOD TO HAVE

 - Experience running a campus event, community, newsletter, side project or a small business.

 - Familiarity with growth channels such as email, SEO, paid acquisition, content, partnerships and community.

 - Familiarity with Canva, Figma, Notion, HubSpot, analytics tools or basic video editing.

If you have work samples that demonstrate strong writing, structured thinking or execution, include them with your application.




WHY SARVAM?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.

 - Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar.

 - High ownership and high impact from day one.

 - Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems.

 - Work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works and communicates.

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.
